_comment: sim-preplace-per-joint-gains-v1: PER-JOINT carried-preplace arm drive so the welded carton stays parallel to the ground (2.0 deg bound / 0.15 s grace, NEVER loosened) AND shoulder_pan HOLDS its goal through the 1.64 rad wrist_2 sweep. ROOT CAUSE (coldwin53, which VALIDATED the PR 341 all-soft swing fix -- CARTON_TICK tilt peak 1.83 deg, no CARTON_TILT trip): under the SOFT drive (eff 400) the carried preplace no longer swings the carton, but shoulder_pan cannot HOLD its goal against the wrist_2 sweep reaction -- it reached -0.009, drifted back to +0.479 and FROZE 0.558 rad short while wrist_2 swept 0.067->1.631, so the standoff never converged -> 'phase timeout: preplace' (119.7 s sim). cw50-52 (STIFF all joints) HELD the pan (reached goal) but the stiff drive swung the carton 3-8 deg -> CARTON_TILT. The pan HOLD and the carton SWING want OPPOSITE gains, and carried_soft_phases is all-joints-per-phase. The fix is a PER-JOINT override: stiffen shoulder_pan (hold the pan), keep the WRISTS (and shoulder_lift/elbow) SOFT (keep the swing fix). Default-OFF (byte-identical); keeps the PR 340 gate + caps + the 2.0/0.15 bound.

_mechanism.1_per_joint_drive_RUNTIME: physics_setup.resolve_joint_overrides / phase_drive_plan honour phase_drive['carried_joint_profile'] = {phase: {joint_name: {kp,kd,eff}}}: the uniform phase gains (soft for a carried_soft_phase) are OVERRIDDEN for the named joints only. For preplace: base SOFT (carried_soft_phases=['preplace'] kills the swing) + shoulder_pan force-STIFF (kp 1e6 / eff 2000, the ceiling cw50-52 proved HOLDS). isaac_port.gate() applies the plan per-joint (set_arm_drive_gains_per_joint) and logs PHASE_DRIVE_JOINT. WHY pan is swing-SAFE to stiffen: it is a near-vertical YAW joint -- the bench tilt-Jacobian at the standoff shows d(carton tilt)/d(shoulder_pan) = 1.67 deg/rad (small) vs 57 deg/rad for shoulder_lift/elbow/wrist_1/wrist_3 (the tilt-injecting joints that MUST stay soft); and pan gravity torque is 0 (vertical axis), rigid-body pan<->wrist_2 coupling is 0.07 kg*m^2 (negligible), so the eff-400 freeze is a drive/solver AUTHORITY artifact, not a torque the physics needs -- the required pan hold effort is bracketed by OBSERVATION: 400 N*m insufficient (cw53), 2000 N*m sufficient (cw50-52). Bench: required ~752 N*m (inferred from the 0.558 drift) < chosen 2000.
_mechanism.2_convergence_guard_HOST: controller convergence_guard.ConvergenceGuard watches the per-joint error to the issued preplace goal; when the worst joint's error stops shrinking for preplace_convergence_stall_s SIM seconds while still un-converged, it FAILS the move by name -- PHASE_CONVERGENCE naming the frozen joint + its error -- instead of running the opaque 120 s phase timeout (coldwin53 would have printed 'PHASE_CONVERGENCE ... joint=ur_shoulder_pan_joint error=0.558 rad ...'). Inert when stall_s<=0.
_mechanism.3_wrist_first_fallback_HOST: preplace_sequence.wrist_first_subgoals: the FALLBACK if the model showed the pan cannot hold at any wrist-soft effort (it CAN -- the per-joint override is the primary). preplace_wrist_first routes the carried preplace as TWO legs: leg 1 drives every joint EXCEPT shoulder_pan to the standoff (the wrist_2 sweep + leveling happen while pan HOLDS at carry), leg 2 moves pan with the wrists already set -- the sweep reaction and the pan travel are DECOUPLED in time. Bench: pan travel during the sweep = 0, wrist_2 travel during the pan leg = 0, two-leg carton tilt 1.77 deg (< 2.0, both legs level).
_mechanism._cpu_proof: scripts/twin/tools/preplace_drive_bench.py run_per_joint: reproduces the cw53 freeze (soft eff 400 -> pan drift 0.558 rad) AND cw50-52 swing (stiff rings the tilt-sensitive joints), shows the chosen per-joint profile HOLDS the pan within 0.02 rad (0.0008) with predicted carton overshoot 0.037 deg (< 1.5), and reports the pan holding torque required (~752 N*m) vs the chosen effort (2000 N*m, 2.7x margin). Tests: test_preplace_per_joint_gains.py.

env._note: UNCHANGED from coldwin53. No new env switch -- the primary fix is the RUNTIME phase_drive.carried_joint_profile sub-key; the guard + fallback are HOST keys.

runtime_config._file: mission-runtime-*.json (EXTERNAL to the repo; the integration lane owns it). The ONLY new key this lane adds is phase_drive.carried_joint_profile; carried_soft_phases (PR 341) and the rest of the coldwin53 block are UNCHANGED.

phase_drive._carried_soft_phases_note: PR 341, KEPT. Runs the carried preplace SOFT (kills the 3-8 deg swing); place/pan stay STIFF.
phase_drive._carried_joint_profile_note: NEW, OPTIONAL (default absent => the PR 341 all-soft preplace => byte-identical). {phase: {joint_name: {kp,kd,eff}}}: OVERRIDES the uniform phase gains for the named joints only. Here it force-STIFFENS shoulder_pan on the carried-soft preplace so it HOLDS against the wrist sweep, while wrist_1/2/3 + shoulder_lift + elbow stay SOFT (the swing fix). config_preflight.check_phase_drive_carried_joint_profile validates the joint names / gain ranges AND REFUSES a WRIST override that raises the wrist effort above the soft ceiling (that would reintroduce the swing). RUNTIME key (isaac_port/physics_setup) -- NOT a HOST key (the host-vs-runtime split would silently drop it). Optional: add ur_shoulder_lift_joint / ur_elbow_joint if the GPU shows they also drift (their gravity load 43/42 N*m is << 400, so the soft drive holds them statically; keep them soft unless proven otherwise).

cart_placement._note: UNCHANGED from coldwin53 (the integration lane owns the resolved place point / support_z; this lane does not touch it).

host_config._file: scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json (resolved by ros_host.py -> TransferController). The coldwin53 carton_level block (preplace_level_gate + the PR 340 preplace_* keys, preplace_above_support, place_contact_release, gravity_compensation K=2850, closed_loop_sensor) is KEPT verbatim. This lane adds the two OPTIONAL keys below.
host_config._preplace_convergence_stall_s_note: NEW, OPTIONAL (default 0 => off => byte-identical). SIM seconds. The preplace frozen-joint convergence guard: if the worst joint's goal error stops shrinking for this long while un-converged, FAIL the move as PHASE_CONVERGENCE naming the joint + error, instead of the opaque 120 s phase timeout. Must be a tighter bound than the 120 s timeout (config_preflight.check_preplace_convergence_keys refuses >= 120). 30 s names a real freeze ~90 s before the timeout.
host_config._preplace_wrist_first_note: NEW, OPTIONAL (default false => byte-identical). The sequencing FALLBACK (deliverable 3): leg 1 moves every joint except shoulder_pan to the standoff (wrist_2 sweep while pan holds), leg 2 moves pan. KEEP FALSE for coldwin54 -- the per-joint drive override (primary) is proven to hold the pan at a wrist-soft effort, so the fallback is not needed; it is shipped + bench-proven in case the GPU shows the pan still cannot hold.
host_config._carton_level_kept: preplace_level_gate true, preplace_gate_bound_deg 1.0, preplace_max_segment_rad 0.08, preplace_approach_speed/accel, preplace_above_support true, place_contact_release true, gravity_compensation {stiffness_nm_per_rad 2850, carton_mass_kg 0.45}, closed_loop_sensor -- the coldwin53 values, UNCHANGED. PR 339 station_place_full_brake + chassis_station_pitch_hold_* (RUNTIME) UNCHANGED.

acceptance_coldwin54._how: relaunch the coldwin53 config with the one new RUNTIME key phase_drive.carried_joint_profile.preplace.ur_shoulder_pan_joint (+ optionally the HOST preplace_convergence_stall_s=30 as a diagnostic net); config_preflight PASS (incl. check_phase_drive_carried_joint_profile + check_preplace_convergence_keys). Watch for PHASE_DRIVE_JOINT phase=preplace -> ...pan[kp=1e+06 eff=2000]... in the Isaac log (proves the override activated RUNTIME-side).
acceptance_coldwin54.preplace_converges: shoulder_pan error <= 0.02 rad at the standoff (no +0.5 rad drift); NO 'phase timeout: preplace', NO PHASE_CONVERGENCE trip
acceptance_coldwin54.CARTON_TICK_preplace_tilt_peak_deg: <= 1.5 (the wrists stay soft; stiffening the yaw pan injects <0.1 deg)
acceptance_coldwin54.no_CARTON_TILT_trip_on_approach: the carried preplace approach does NOT sustain over 2.0 deg for the 0.15 s grace
acceptance_coldwin54.full_D6_lock_engages_at_place_start: PR 339 full-D6 base lock (STILL UNEXERCISED after 5 runs): base drift <= 0.02 m over the loaded place descent
acceptance_coldwin54.release_at_true_shelf_contact: PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE fires at the resolved support top; carton rests level on the shelf
acceptance_coldwin54.verify_place_pass: post-place verification passes; the run advances PAST collect (into couple)
acceptance_coldwin54._if_pan_still_drifts: raise the pan eff toward 2000 is already max; add ur_shoulder_lift_joint/ur_elbow_joint to carried_joint_profile, OR set preplace_wrist_first=true (the sequencing fallback). The convergence guard will NAME whichever joint froze.
